tech.summary: Nvidia ne Q3 FY27 mein $115.8bn revenue report kiya — pichle saal se 103% zyada, aur apne $108bn guide se $7.8bn upar. Data Center revenue $107.6bn raha, EPS $2.68. Q4 ke liye $130bn ka guide diya. Lekin earnings call ki asli khabar ye thi: chairman Harvey Jones ne kaha board ka Jensen Huang ko CEO wapas lane ka koi irada nahi hai, jab ke Huang ne kaha tha ke agar bulaya gaya to wapas aane par 'honored' hoga. Board ne National Security and Export Control Oversight Committee bhi bana diya hai.
tech.title: Nvidia ki revenue double — $115.8bn, lekin Huang ki wapsi par board ne darwaza band kar diya

tech.summary: OpenAI ne 17 Nov ko GPT-6.2 Astra aur Sol release kiye — ChatGPT Work aur Codex mein Plus, Pro, Enterprise aur Edu users ke liye. Astra ki API qeemat 20% kam hui ($8 input / $40 output per million tokens), Sol $2/$10 par wahi raha. Artificial Analysis ke mutabiq Astra ka Intelligence Index 62 (pehle 57) aur Sol ka 57 (pehle 55) hai. Dono models ko cybersecurity mein 'Critical' rating mili — Astra pehla model hai jise AI self-improvement mein 'High' rating di gayi, is liye higher-risk cyber help par sakht pabandiyan bhi lagi hain.
tech.title: OpenAI ne GPT-6.2 Astra aur Sol launch kar diye — tez, saste, lekin zyada khatarnak bhi

tech.summary: Google ne 17 Nov ko Gemini ke Tasks mode ko US, Japan, Korea, Canada, Australia aur India mein free kar diya — pehle ye $19.99/month AI Pro ka feature tha. Ab Gemini naye Gemini 4 Hydrogen model par chal kar dukaanon ko call kar ke appointment book kar sakta hai, Google Pay se khareedari kar sakta hai (Agent Payments Protocol), email forward kar ke calendar bana sakta hai aur text se bhi task le sakta hai. Calls aur payments pehle sirf US mein hain; khareedari se pehle Gemini confirmation mangta hai aur spending cap set ki ja sakti hai.
tech.title: Google ka Gemini Tasks ab free — AI ab aap ke liye call karega, bill bharega, kaam karega

tech.summary: Anthropic ki IPO aaj (18 Nov) price hone wali hai, kal Nasdaq par ANT ticker se trading shuru hogi. Range $70–78 per share hai — 825 million shares bech kar $64.4bn tak raise honge, fully diluted valuation taqreeban $1.4 trillion. Bloomberg ke mutabiq demand supply se 6 guna zyada hai. Lekin SEC filing mein $900.9bn ke multi-year infrastructure commitments bhi hain, aur Q3 revenue growth 144% se gir kar 47% reh gayi hai — is liye ye IPO poori AI trade ka litmus test ban gaya hai.
tech.title: Anthropic ki IPO pricing aaj — $70–78 per share, $1.4 trillion valuation ka imtehan

tech.summary: Interim CEO Colette Kress ne earnings call par kaha ke Nvidia ab China ko H200 chips nahi bechega — ye wohi arrangement khatam hua jo Jensen Huang aur Donald Trump ne banaya tha, jis mein chips US se guzar kar 25% tariff ke saath bheje jate the. Faisla usi din aaya jab board ne export-control oversight committee banayi aur US ne naye rules issue kiye jo foreign data centers se Chinese customers ko chips ki remote access par rok lagate hain. Jefferies ka andaza hai ke naye rules se agle saal data center revenue $44–62bn kam ho sakta hai.
tech.title: Nvidia ne China ko H200 chips bechna band kar diya — Huang ka Trump deal khatam

tech.summary: Uber taqreeban 150,000 drivers ko notify kar raha hai ke un ke naam, pate, date of birth aur driver's license numbers chori ho gaye — breach Uber ke andar nahi, us ke AI vendor Fireworks AI ke systems mein hui, jahan hackers ne October mein internal credentials chura kar Uber ka data access kiya. Oregon ki filing ke mutabiq 149,346 log mutasir hue. Fireworks ki breach se Notion aur Cursor ka data bhi leak hua tha. Uber ne vendor ka access kaat diya aur mutasir drivers ko free credit monitoring offer ki hai.
tech.title: Uber ke 150,000 drivers ka data leak — AI vendor Fireworks ki breach se license details chori

pakistan.summary: Dhaka mein SAFF Championship final mein Pakistan pehle half mein Alamgir Ghazi ke goal se 1-0 aage tha, lekin 60th minute mein Junaid Shah ko red card mila aur India ne 10 khiladion ke khilaf do goal kar ke 2-1 se jeet liya — India ka 10th title aur lagatar teesri jeet. Pakistan pehli dafa final mein pahuncha tha; semi-final mein Bangladesh ko 1-0 se haraya tha. Haar ke bawajood ye run Pakistani football ke liye aik bari milestone hai.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ne SAFF final mein jeeta hua match haara — India ne 2-1 se title apne naam kiya

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne Asia Cup Blind Cricket Tournament ke semi-final mein defending champions India ko aik wicket se hara diya — 180 ka target aakhri ball par poora hua, jab Niamatullah ne aakhri do balls par chhakka aur chauka lagaya. Captain Nisar Ali ne 64 runs banaye aur player of the match bane. Final 20 Nov ko hoga; India ko final mein pahunchnay ke liye pehle Bangladesh ko harana hoga.
pakistan.title: Blind Asia Cup final mein Pakistan — India ko last ball par hara kar final mein jagah banayi

pakistan.summary: Asian Development Bank ne Tuesday ko Pakistan ke federal civil pension system ki reform ke liye $500 million ka results-based loan approve kiya. Federal pension spending FY16 se taqreeban 5 guna barh kar saalana Rs1 trillion se zyada ho chuki hai. Loan pehle phase ki Pension Reform Implementation Plan aur defined contribution scheme ki transition mein madad karega — July 2024 se appoint hone wale federal employees ke liye ye scheme lazmi hai.
pakistan.title: ADB ne Pakistan ko pension reforms ke liye $500m approve kar diye

pakistan.summary: Pakistan Stock Exchange par Tuesday ko volatile session raha: KSE-100 pehle 1,268 points chadha, phir profit-taking ne saari gains mita di — index 665 points (0.37%) gir kar 177,517.74 par band hua. Volume 37% gir kar 839 million shares reh gaya. Achhi khabar: October mein current account $39m surplus mein raha aur IT exports 17% barh kar record $453m ho gayin — 4MFY27 mein kul $1.7bn.
pakistan.title: PSX mein utaar charhao — KSE-100 665 points gir kar 177,517 par band

pakistan.summary: Chief of Defence Forces aur Army Chief Field Marshal Asim Munir ne Rawalpindi mein alag alag mulaqaton mein British Army Chief Gen Sir Charles Roland Vincent Walker aur Turkish Air Force Commander Gen Rafet Dalkiran se difaai taawun barhane par baat ki. ISPR ke mutabiq regional security aur bilateral military cooperation par guftugu hui. Is se pehle is mahine Pakistan aur UK ne counterterrorism, narcotics aur cybercrime par security cooperation mazboot karne par bhi ittefaq kiya tha.
pakistan.title: Asim Munir ne UK aur Turkiye ke fauji sarbarahon se difaai taawun par baat ki

pakistan.summary: Pakistan ne Monday ko UN Security Council mein Israel ke Syria mein musalsal hamlay aur ghuspaith ki shadeed muzammat ki — fori khatma, occupied areas se wapsi aur 1974 Disengagement Agreement par amal ka mutalba kiya. Ambassador Syed Haider Shah ne kaha ke occupied Golan international law ke tehet Syrian territory hai. Pakistan ne Syria ki political transition, reconstruction aur US/EU/UK ki taraf se sanctions mein narmi ka bhi khair-maqdam kiya.
pakistan.title: Pakistan ne Syria mein Israeli hamlay ki shadeed muzammat kar di
